name: Enóphilo Wine Fest 2026
description: Taste more than 350 wines from about 40 Portuguese producers at the Alfândega do Porto congress centre on 21 November, from 15:00 to 20:00. Tickets from €19.90.
longDescription:
The Enóphilo Wine Fest is back in Porto for its 11th edition in the city. Around 40 small and medium-sized Portuguese wine producers will pour more than 350 wines, and there are three special tastings as well.

A general ticket gets you into the open tasting with every producer and includes a loan glass, which you return when you leave. A double ticket for two people costs €30 in total. The Cool Driver pack gives a group that buys four tickets a fifth ticket free for its designated driver. Tickets don't include the special tastings.

The festival is at the Centro de Congressos da Alfândega do Porto on Saturday 21 November 2026, from 15:00 to 20:00. It's aimed at adults. Under-18s get in free with an adult. The venue is accessible for people with reduced mobility. Tickets from €19.90.
